name: gitmunk
description: 🐿️ gitmunk: a pocket-sized toolkit of agent skills, guardrail hooks and GitHub workflows for Claude Code and Codex.

plugins.name: dev-skills
plugins.description: 🐿️ Review PRs in bounded rounds, refine issues into work orders, explain pending decisions, compact long threads, squash merge with a closeout, track discussion series, and plan features and stories (FT_/STY_ docs).

plugins.name: dev-hooks
plugins.description: 🐿️ Guardrail and audit hooks: deny destructive or secret-reading calls, block merging other people's PRs, log redacted events.
